shipped_rows.title_o: INTERNATIONALIZATION AND FIRM GOVERNANCE: THE ROLES OF CEO COMPENSATION, TOP TEAM COMPOSITION, AND BOARD STRUCTURE.
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: Our results find general support for Sanders and Carpenter’s (1998) central premise that internationalization shapes firm governance structures but also highlight important non-findings that reflect how the internationalization-governance relationship has changed since their study.

new_primary_evidence: Complete publisher abstract, not full text. Fresh independent blind coding after old source was found to have an empty Abstract heading. Old undeterminable source-gap adjudications are archived and remain historical, not evidence about the newly visible abstract. Review author overall verdict before individual effects; do not equate general support alone with complete agreement.
